original_bullet: Connect genuine assessment and assessor evidence.
existing_owner: Existing domain author(s); sole canonical integration/release owner retained; no new write lease claimed
next_action: Bind authoritative assessor/credential sources to current roles and learners; reject self-certified or absent evidence; test route-to-readiness consequences.
observed_evidence: Current adaptive source requires independently observed success; passive practice cannot certify, independently exercised in 18/18 local tests. External assessor evidence not established.
required_completion: Current exact integrated version; intended-role workflow; authoritative backend and durable state; refresh/fresh-login; applicable provider acceptance and independent readback; audit; independent security/recovery proof.
model_policy: Efficient available Sol/Codex for triage/development; independent reviewer; escalate only hard safety/security/payroll/recovery questions. Actual model selection/dispatch must be recorded, not assumed.
